summary: The exclusion dialect .mitig8it.yml uses, stated once for both implementations.
why: The App excludes paths in services/api-service/src/services/repositoryConfig.js and the
Action excludes them in action/orchestrator/repo_config.py. A repository that adds an
exclusion has to see the same files skipped whichever one reviews it, so neither side is
free to have its own idea of what a glob means. Both read the cases below and both are

dialect.anchored: Patterns match the whole repository-relative path, not a suffix of it.
dialect.star: * matches any run of characters except /
dialect.question: ? matches exactly one character except /
dialect.globstar: ** as a whole segment matches zero or more segments
dialect.trailing_globstar: a/** matches a and everything under it
dialect.leading_globstar: **/x matches x at any depth, including the root
dialect.directory_prefix: a pattern with no wildcard also excludes everything under it, so `build` excludes `build/main.js`
dialect.empty: an empty or whitespace-only pattern matches nothing

match_cases.name: a trailing globstar covers the whole subtree
a single star does not cross a separator
a leading globstar matches at any depth including the root
a globstar in the middle spans zero or more segments
a question mark is exactly one character and never a separator
a wildcard-free pattern names a file or a directory
a leading ./ or / on either side is not part of the path
regex metacharacters in a pattern are literal
no patterns at all excludes nothing

parse_cases.name: a block sequence is the documented form
a flow sequence parses the same way
comments and blank lines are ignored
parse_cases.yaml:
# what this repository does not review

exclude:
  - a/**   # generated

parse_cases.name: an unknown key is ignored, so a newer file still works on an older reader
an absent exclude key is an empty list
an empty file is an empty list
an explicitly null exclude is an empty list
non-string entries are refused rather than coerced
a scalar exclude is refused, because one glob is still a list
a mapping at the top level is required
text that is not YAML is refused
